descriptions.before: A read only property that returns true when the AnimationTrack is playing.
descriptions.after: A read-only property that returns true when the AnimationTrack is playing.

descriptions.before: A read only property that returns the length (in seconds) of an AnimationTrack. This will return 0 until the animation has fully loaded and thus may not be immediately available.
descriptions.after: A read-only property that returns the length (in seconds) of an AnimationTrack. This will return 0 until the animation has fully loaded and thus may not be immediately available.

descriptions.before: The Speed of an AnimationTrack is a read only property that gives the current playback speed of the AnimationTrack. This has a default value of 1. When speed is equal to 1, the amount of time an animation takes to complete is equal to AnimationTrack.Length (in seconds).
descriptions.after: Read-only property that gives the current playback speed of the AnimationTrack.

descriptions.before: Read-only property that gives the current weight of the AnimationTrack. It has a default value of 1.
descriptions.after: Read-only property that gives the current weight of the AnimationTrack.

descriptions.before: Changes the AnimationTrack.Speed of an animation. A positive value for speed plays the animation forward, a negative one plays it backwards, and 0 pauses it.
descriptions.after: Changes the AnimationTrack.Speed of an animation. A positive value for speed plays the animation forward, a negative one plays it backwards, and 0 pauses it.

descriptions.before: Changes the weight of an animation, with the optional fadeTime parameter determining how long it takes for AnimationTrack.WeightCurrent to reach AnimationTrack.WeightTarget.
descriptions.after: Changes the weight of an animation, with the optional fadeTime parameter determining how long it takes for AnimationTrack.WeightCurrent to reach AnimationTrack.WeightTarget.

descriptions.before: Plays the AnimationTrack. Once called an AnimationTrack will play with the specified fadeTime, weight and speed.
descriptions.after: Plays the AnimationTrack. Once called an AnimationTrack will play with the specified fadeTime, weight and speed.

descriptions.before: Fires when the AnimationTrack is completely done moving anything in the world. The animation has finished playing, the "fade out" is finished, and the subject is in a neutral pose.
descriptions.after: Fires when the AnimationTrack is completely done moving anything in the world.

descriptions.before: Fires every time playback of an AnimationTrack reaches a Keyframe that does not have the default name - "Keyframe.".
descriptions.after: Fires every time playback of an AnimationTrack reaches a Keyframe that does not have the default name of Keyframe.

descriptions.before: An object that represents a presently connected client to the game.
descriptions.after: An object that represents a presently connected client to the experience.

descriptions.before: Determines whether the character's appearance will be loaded when the player spawns. If false, the player will spawn with a default appearance.
descriptions.after: Determines whether the character's appearance will be loaded when the player spawns. If false, the player will spawn with a default appearance.

descriptions.before: Determines the user ID of the account whose character appearance is used for a player's character.
descriptions.after: Determines the user ID of the account whose character appearance is used for a player's Character.

descriptions.before: Determines player's camera movement mode when using a desktop version of Roblox.
descriptions.after: Determines player's camera movement mode when using a device with a mouse and keyboard.

descriptions.before: Determines player's character movement mode when using a desktop version of Roblox.
descriptions.after: Determines player's character movement mode when using a device with a mouse and keyboard.

descriptions.before: Determines player's camera movement mode when using a touch device.
descriptions.after: Determines player's camera movement mode when using a touch-enabled device.

descriptions.before: Determines player's character movement mode when using a touch device.
descriptions.after: Determines player's character movement mode when using a touch-enabled device.

descriptions.before: The DisplayName of the UserId associated with the Player.
descriptions.after: The display name of the authenticated user associated with the Player.

descriptions.before: Describes the user ID of the player who was followed into a game by a player.
descriptions.after: Describes the user ID of the player who was followed into an experience by a player.

descriptions.before: Indicates if a player has a Verified Badge.
descriptions.after: Indicates if a player has a Verified badge.

descriptions.before: Sets the distance at which this player will see other Humanoid's health bars. If set to 0, the health bars will not be displayed.
descriptions.after: Sets the distance at which this player will see other players' health bars.

descriptions.before: This property shows the locale id that the local player has set for their Roblox account.
descriptions.after: This property shows the locale ID that the local player has set for their Roblox account.

descriptions.before: Sets the distance at which this player will see other Humanoid's names. If set to 0, names are hidden.
descriptions.after: Sets the distance at which this player will see other players' names.

descriptions.before: Determines the Team with which a Player is associated.
descriptions.after: Determines the Team with which the player is associated.

descriptions.before: Determines the Team with which a Player is associated.
descriptions.after: Determines the Team with which the player is associated with according to that team's Team.TeamColor.

descriptions.before: Removes all accessories and other character appearance objects from a player's Character.
descriptions.after: Removes all accessories and other character appearance objects from a player's Character.

descriptions.before: Returns the distance between the character's head and the given Vector3 point. Returns 0 if the player has no character.
descriptions.after: Returns the distance between the character's head and the given Vector3, or 0 if the player has no character.

descriptions.before: Returns a dictionary containing information describing how the Player joins the experience.
descriptions.after: Returns a dictionary containing information describing how the player joins the experience.

descriptions.before: Forcibly disconnect a player from the game, optionally providing a message.
descriptions.after: Forcibly disconnect a player from the experience, optionally providing a message.

descriptions.before: Sets the AccountAge of the player.
descriptions.after: Sets the AccountAge of the player.

descriptions.before: Returns the player's rank in the group as an integer between 0 and 255, where 0 is a non-member and 255 is the group's owner.
descriptions.after: Returns the player's rank in the group as an integer.

descriptions.before: Returns the player's role in the group as a string, or "Guest" if the player isn't part of the group.
descriptions.after: Returns the player's role in the group as a string, or Guest if the player isn't part of the group.

descriptions.before: The groupId of the specified group.
descriptions.after: The group ID of the specified group.

descriptions.before: The player's role in the specified group, or Guest if the player is not a member.
descriptions.after: The player's role in the specified group, or Guest if the player is not a member.

descriptions.before: The groupId of the specified group.
descriptions.after: The group ID of the specified group.

descriptions.before: Spawns an avatar so it has everything equipped in the passed in HumanoidDescription.
descriptions.after: Spawns a player character with everything equipped in the passed in HumanoidDescription.

descriptions.before: Fired when a player's character spawns or respawns.
descriptions.after: Fires when a player's character spawns or respawns.

descriptions.before: Fires when the full appearance of a Player.Character has been inserted.
descriptions.after: Fires when the full appearance of a Character has been inserted.

descriptions.before: Fired right before a player's character is removed.
descriptions.after: Fires right before a player's character is removed.

descriptions.before: Fires when a player chats in-game using Roblox's provided chat bar.
descriptions.after: Fires when a player chats in experience using Roblox's provided chat bar.

descriptions.before: This event fires approximately two minutes after the game engine classifies the player as idle. Time is the number of seconds that have elapsed since that point.
descriptions.after: This event fires approximately two minutes after the engine classifies the player as idle. Time is the number of seconds that have elapsed since that point.

descriptions.before: Fired when the TeleportState of a player changes.
descriptions.after: Fires when the teleport state of a player changes.

descriptions.before: Applies to BasePart only.
descriptions.after: Applies to BasePart only. Note that refraction of light through this material is not supported on mobile devices due to computational limitations.

descriptions.before: Must be used on a MeshPart with UVs laid out to cover much of the 0:1 UV space or more (larger is better). The MeshPart must also have a texture applied to its TextureID, and that texture image must have a wide value range since the material displays the range from dark/black to light/white values. Obtain this model for a functional example of the ForceField material.
descriptions.after: Must be used on a MeshPart with UVs laid out to cover much of the 0:1 UV space or more (larger is better). The MeshPart must also have a texture applied to its TextureID, and that texture image must have a wide value range since the material displays the range from dark/black to light/white values. Obtain this model for a functional example.
